check.claim: The mpeg_card.bin image Beetle Saturn loads changes what the Saturn BIOS shows and does for a Video CD.
check.method: Saturn BIOS v1.00a (mpr-17933), region forced to North America, Video CD Card option enabled, automatic RTC left on and the host clock frozen at 2000-01-01 00:00:00 by libfaketime 0.9.10 so runs are deterministic, the authored Video CD inserted. 3000 frames; Saturn A (libretro B) held 15 frames from frame 1300, which is Play on the BIOS CD player, and Start 15 frames from frame 1900. Repeated with each mpeg_card.bin image, with no file, with 512 KiB of zeros and with a 1-byte file; every other input is identical. Each variant runs twice in fresh processes.

result.statement: video_sha1 is identical across all 11 variants
